page.layout: One column of running text with Hebrew and Latin entries; large Hebrew headwords hang in the left margin, beside the entries they head. Running head at top, page number at top right. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: מחוק Ch.Ornamentum muliebre.Respondet Hebræo כּוּמָז Cingula pendula vel bullata muliebris, Exo.35.22.in Onk.Plur. מְחוּכִין, ibid. in Jon. Numer.31.50. in Jonath. legitur מְחוּכָיָא מְגִירָת תְּרֵייהוֹן Unde apparet esse ornamentum pectoris circa mammas. In Targ. Hierosol. ibidem est מְעוּכָיָא unde Elias putat esse ornamenta ad comprimendas mammas. Nam מְעַךְ Comprimere.
מחכיא Chal. Aciaria, Jesa.3.22. Respondet Hebræo חריטים.
מחק Chald. Radere, abradere, delere, expungere, יִמְחוֹק לְמַיָּא מְרִירָיָא Delebit aquis amaris istis, Numer. 5.23.
מחקא Hostorium, Rasorium, quo superfluum & redundans in modio dejicitur, Levit.19.35.in Jon.
מחר מָחָר Ch. & Syr.Cras, craftinum tempus, posthac, in posterum, יוֹמָא דְמָחָר Dies craftinus.
מחרת מחתית, מחותירת, מחתתא Vide in נחרת.

מטא מטי, מטָא Ch. & Syr. Venire, advenire, appropinquare, pervenire, supervenire, pertingere, contingere, Ithpeh. אִתְמְטִי Ire, abire, accedere, pervenire, pertingere. Ithpahel אִתְמְטִי Idem. Pahel Syr. Idem, Act.9.3. Aph. אַמְטִי Pertingere, pervenire facere, applicare, admovere.
מטו Ch. Obsecratio, petitio, rogatio: Plerumque usurpatur cum praepositione ב, בְּמָטוּ Cum petitione, id est, Quæsò, obsecrò: Idem quod בִּבְעוּ. Absque praepos.

page.notes: Hebrew and Aramaic headwords in the left margin are large, set outside the text block; they are transcribed in place at the start of each entry. Some Hebrew vocalisation is faint and has been copied as best seen; exact pointing is uncertain. The last line "praepos." sits at the right, set off from the text.
